name: Standard
description: Ask questions, open apps, or search the web.

name: Mark 1 · Basic
description: Typed commands, app launches, web search, and answers.

name: Mark 2 · Voice
description: Arm voice here, then say ‘Hey Jarvis’ and your command.

name: Mark 3 · Desktop
description: Inspect an accessible window or enter ‘plan in "window title" to …’ to review each desktop action.

name: Mark 5 · Offline Tray
description: Open JARVIS from the Windows tray and use a small installed model offline.

name: Mark 6 · Power Saving
description: Enter on, off, or status to control when Marks starts heavy steps.

name: Mark 7 · Instant Deploy
description: Call this compact workspace from the optional Windows shortcut.

name: Mark 17 · Heartbreaker
description: Find an exact file or review a desktop action. Try ‘windows’ to begin.

name: Mark 22 · Hotrod
description: Time, date, and arithmetic through the rule engine.

name: Mark 33 · Silver Centurion
description: Private text chat using installed local Ollama, with no saved history.

name: Mark 38 · Igor
description: Preview file prefixes, Office-to-text conversion, and CSV cleanup in a JARVIS folder.

name: Mark 39 · Gemini
description: Compare evidence and generate a cited research report.

name: Mark 40 · Shotgun
description: Review a multi-tool task with web search, code, Office files, terminal info, and read-only account access.

name: Mark 42 · Iron Legion
description: Run up to two independent read-and-draft helpers. Enter one task per line.

name: Mark 44 · Veronica
description: Review and quarantine files by extension in a JARVIS folder, with originals retained for restoration.

name: Mark 46 · Mission
description: Review a read-and-draft plan, then run it with checkpoints for up to four hours.

name: Mark 47 · Tutor
description: Explain concepts, quiz yourself, or prepare study notes.

name: Mark 50 · Nanotech
description: Draft and approve reusable text tools. Enter ‘tools’ to see the registered list.

name: Mark 85 · Endgame
description: Manage approved memory or run another profile with ‘use mark-22 what time is it?’. Enter ‘memories’ to review saved notes.

name: House Party Protocol
description: Queue up to ten read-and-draft tasks, one per line.

name: Friday
description: Use a casual, concise voice for typed replies.

name: Sentry
description: Watch for email from a specific sender, a named download, or a named deadline. Enter ‘watches’ or ‘alerts’ to review.

name: Damage Report
description: Check internet, microphone permission, and the local model.
